bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖，跌破 $54.8，逼近 $50

read.en: Intel fell 10.3% on Nov 5 to $52.25, trading between $51.71 and $56.73 on volume about twice its 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($59.4), 10-day ($75.6), 30-day ($95.8) and 100-day ($102.4) averages and the rising 200-day ($87.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($90.11), and RSI is 21, deeply oversold.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月5日下跌 10.3%，收于 $52.25，盘中区间 $51.71–56.73，成交量约为 20 日均量的两倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$59.4）、10 日（$75.6）、30 日（$95.8）和 100 日均线（$102.4）以及上行的 200 日均线（$87.0）下方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$90.11），RSI 为 21，深度超卖。

read.en: The close broke the $56.8 Nov 4 low and the $54.8 Apr 8 low, now resistance; the $56.73 high stopped at the Nov 4 low. Resistance is $53.1–54.8 (Jan 22 range, Apr 8 low), then $56.7–56.8 and $58.3–60.2 (Nov 4 close, Apr 9 low, Nov 4 high). Support is $51.5–51.7 (Nov 5 low, Feb 3 high), then $50–50.2 (round number, Jan 21 low) and $46.8–47.0 (Feb 4–5 lows). A close above $54.8 would target $56.8; below $51.5, $50.

r.en: Jan 22 low $53.08 and high $54.6; Apr 8 low $54.8, lost
Nov 4 close $58.3; Apr 9 low $58.4; Nov 4 high $60.2
